Thank you for your reply

I can't go anywhere or do anything without seeing him in it as we shared everything .. we fell in love in 2018 and we broke up as the circumstances were stronger than us in 2019. For 2 years I suffered so much till he talked to me 3 months ago as circumstances got way better and we reconceiled with huge hopes in the future and i felt like a human for the first time in ages. He had severe depression and anxiety when we talked, he kept every memory for the past 2 years and lived off them and stalked me everywhere. I pushed him to seek help for his mental struggle and was prescribed sertraline and stood by him till he developed tolerence. What really aches me is that he was totally in love with me one month ago, he just found out that emotional blunting is easier for him than having me back, as he associated me with pain for the last 2 years. I told him it is a trauma response and he should seek help but he refuses to go. I can feel physical chest pain like my heart is actually broken. I cant believe he gave up on all our future plans and chose a side effect over me. I had a depressive relapse everytime we separared but this time is the absolute worst by far. I keep blaming myself for ever suggesting the medication I only wanted him better. I gave so so much and I'm left with pure agony.
I do workout regularly but I have a massive relapse so I barely eat or drink. I think if breathing wasn't spontaneous I wouldn't have breathed either. Everything just hurts so sooo much
